notes.title: and the winner is: ARENA GODS!
notes.content:
+1 Award Unlocked!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28598884/20b9be122377ecce82378266807d64c82487aee1.jpg[/img]

Last week on December 6, 7 and 8 ARENA GODS team attended to LevelUY on the beautiful charming Montevideo. 
We won the #LEVELUY Award 2017 - in partnership with Casual Connect & #IndiePrize!
We had a blast at the conference as we received a great warm treatment from our fellow Uruguayan Dev community and event attendees.
Very special thanks to Jesús Fabre and all the organization. You guys did an awesome job!
Thank you #Uruguay, we had SUCH a good time! And certainly, want to be back to this wonderful nation!

notes.title: What comes next?

Wow!!

This is day #3 since we launched on Steam Early Access.
It's being crazy as we expected since this is our first Steam launch! We are very excited with all the feedback.

-Cinematic last kill Replay
